info.title: TabPFN Tabular Prediction
info.description: A REST API for in-context tabular prediction with the TabPFN foundation model (Prior Labs TabPFN 3.5 family). Send labeled training rows and the rows to predict in a single request; the model returns predictions immediately without a separate training step.

post.summary: Make in-context tabular predictions for the provided test rows based on the provided training rows.
post.description:
Make in-context tabular predictions with TabPFN. The labeled training data (`x_train`, `y_train`) and the rows to predict (`x_test`) are sent in a single request. Two request encodings are supported: inline JSON (`application/json`) and multipart file upload (`multipart/form-data`).

Data limits: up to 1,000,000 context rows and 2,000 columns; context and prediction data together are limited to 200,000,000 cells. Classification supports up to 160 distinct classes. Prediction rows are capped at 1,000,000 (250,000 when the context has 1,000,000 rows). Responses are capped at 32,000,000 output values (e.g. returning probabilities for all 160 classes permits at most 200,000 prediction rows). Full regression-distribution output is limited to 400 prediction rows.

classification_example.description: Predict a spend category from line-item data using in-context learning.

regression_example.description: Predict a numeric target using in-context learning with row-oriented data.

regression_advanced_example.description: Predict quantiles with custom model options.

example.detail: Invalid input data: x_test must have the same columns as x_train.

ClassificationOutputType.title: ClassificationOutputType
ClassificationOutputType.description: Output type for classification tasks. `probas` (default): per-class probabilities. `preds`: predicted class label. `top_k`: top-k class positions — requires the `top_k` parameter.

RegressionOutputType.title: RegressionOutputType
RegressionOutputType.description: Output type for regression tasks. `mean` (default): predicted mean. `median`: predicted median. `mode`: predicted mode. `quantiles`: one value per requested quantile — requires the `quantiles` parameter. `main`: point estimates plus quantiles. `full`: mean, median, mode, quantiles, and full predictive distribution — max 400 prediction rows.

FitMode.title: FitMode
FitMode.description: Preprocessing/caching strategy used by the model. Default: `fit_preprocessors`.

CellValue.title: CellValue
CellValue.description: A single cell value. Non-finite values (infinities) are serialized as null.

ColumnOrientedData.title: ColumnOrientedData
ColumnOrientedData.description: Column-oriented tabular data: a mapping of column names to their list of values. Maximum 2,000 columns.

RowOrientedData.title: RowOrientedData
RowOrientedData.description: Row-oriented tabular data: a list of rows, where each row is a list of cell values. Maximum 2,000 values per row.

TrainingFeatures.title: TrainingFeatures
TrainingFeatures.description: Training or test features. Either column-oriented (object of column name to list of values) or row-oriented (list of rows). `x_test` must have the same columns as `x_train`. Up to 1,000,000 rows and 2,000 columns; context and prediction data together are limited to 200,000,000 cells.

TrainingTarget.title: TrainingTarget
TrainingTarget.description: Training target. Exactly one column, aligned row-for-row with `x_train`. May be column-oriented (object with a single key) or a flat list of values. For regression the target must be numeric. For classification, up to 160 distinct classes are supported.

PredictParams.description: Controls what the prediction contains. Nested under `task_config.predict_params`.

output_type.description: What the prediction contains. Defaults to `probas` for classification and `mean` for regression.

quantiles.description: A list of floats between 0 and 1 (e.g. [0.1, 0.5, 0.9]). Required when `output_type` is `quantiles`.
quantiles.title: Quantiles

top_k.description: Number of top classes to return. Required when `output_type` is `top_k` (classification only).
top_k.title: Top K

PredictParams.title: PredictParams

TabpfnConfig.description: Model options for TabPFN. All options are optional and nested under `task_config.tabpfn_config`.

n_estimators.description: Ensemble members per prediction; latency scales linearly. Package default is 8 and may increase for very wide tables.
n_estimators.title: N Estimators

softmax_temperature.description: Sharpness of the predicted distribution. Lower values produce more confident predictions.
softmax_temperature.title: Softmax Temperature

average_before_softmax.description: Whether ensemble outputs are averaged before or after the softmax.
average_before_softmax.title: Average Before Softmax

balance_probabilities.description: Classification only. Re-balances predicted probabilities across classes.
balance_probabilities.title: Balance Probabilities

categorical_features_indices.description: Column positions to force to categorical. Column types are inferred by default.
categorical_features_indices.title: Categorical Features Indices

memory_saving_mode.description: Trades speed for lower memory use. Auto-selected by dataset size when unset (enabled from 10,000 training rows).
memory_saving_mode.title: Memory Saving Mode

inference_config.description: Advanced, fine-grained inference overrides. For expert use.

Prediction.description:
The predictions. Shape depends on the task and `output_type`.
- classification / probas: list of rows; each row is a list of class probabilities.
- classification / preds: flat list of predicted labels (one per test row).
- classification / top_k: object with `classes` and `values` arrays (one inner list per test row).
- regression / mean, median, mode: flat list of numbers (one per test row).
- regression / quantiles: list of lists, one inner list per requested quantile.
- regression / main: object with point estimates and quantiles.
- regression / full: object keyed by mean, median, mode, quantiles, and distribution.

anyOf.description: classification / probas: list of rows of class probabilities.
classification / preds or regression / mean, median, mode: flat list of values.
regression / quantiles: list of lists, one inner list per requested quantile.
classification / top_k: object with classes and values arrays.
regression / main: point estimates plus quantiles.
regression / full: rich object with mean, median, mode, quantiles, and distribution.
